segments.speaker: Leah Cohen
segments.text: Thanks for hopping on. I want to understand how your support team handles escalations today.

segments.speaker: Victor Osei
segments.text: Escalations go to a shared inbox, and honestly things slip. Last week two urgent tickets waited over a day.

segments.speaker: Leah Cohen
segments.text: That's painful. Would routing urgent tickets to Slack with an owner help?

segments.speaker: Victor Osei
segments.text: Yes, as long as there's an audit trail. Our compliance team will ask for that.

segments.speaker: Leah Cohen
segments.text: Great. I'll send over our audit log documentation and a pilot plan by Friday.
